title: A site that fits the business it represents.
description: These concept sites show how the design can change to suit different businesses and customers.

items.name: Industrial
items.description: A concept for an industrial service business, with clear service information and a direct path to request a quote.

items.name: Terra Brutal
items.description: A concept for a landscaping business that shows its personality while making services and contact details easy to find.

items.name: Minimalist
items.description: A concept for a creative business that puts the work first and gives interested visitors a simple way to inquire.
